businessRequirements.title: Only the six listed transactions are supported
businessRequirements.statement: A MasterCard fleet transaction must be one of POS Purchase/Capture, POS Authorization Only, CAT Purchase/Capture, CAT Authorization Only, POS Return/Refund or POS Reversal/Void.

businessRequirements.title: Enabled fleet BINs are processed with fleet card type 080
businessRequirements.statement: A card in the MasterCard fleet BIN ranges is processed with a Prompt Code ending in card type 080 when Terminal Special Code 034 is enabled and fleet cards are allowed; non-fleet BINs must not use card type 080.

businessRequirements.title: Fleet BINs fall back to regular MasterCard when the merchant is not set up
businessRequirements.statement: When the Merchant Profile is not set up for MasterCard fleet, a fleet-BIN card is sent as a regular MasterCard transaction using card type 020.

businessRequirements.title: Fleet processing requires Table Load card type 080 or an alternative method
businessRequirements.statement: The POS application allows MasterCard fleet processing only when the Table Load response contains card type 080 or, without Table Load, another method allows fleet cards.

businessRequirements.title: Driver ID or ID Number is 1 to 6 digits when the Product Type requires it
businessRequirements.statement: When the Product Type Code (or manual entry) requires a Driver ID or ID Number, it is 1 to 6 unencrypted digits.

businessRequirements.title: Odometer is 1 to 8 digits when the Product Type requires it
businessRequirements.statement: When the Product Type Code (or manual entry) requires an odometer reading, it is 1 to 8 digits.

businessRequirements.title: Vehicle Number is 1 to 6 digits when the Product Type requires it
businessRequirements.statement: When the Product Type Code requires a Vehicle Number, it is 1 to 6 digits.

businessRequirements.title: Manual entry follows three unsuccessful swipe attempts
businessRequirements.statement: Manual entry is used only after the magnetic stripe cannot be read in three attempts.
businessRequirements.interpretation: The source says swipe again up to three times and then refers to three attempts; this draft counts three attempts in total.

businessRequirements.title: Manual entry carries the full 16-digit account number
businessRequirements.statement: Manual entry includes all 6 ISO digits and all 10 account digits.

businessRequirements.title: The device validates the expiration date
businessRequirements.statement: The device performs an expiration date validation on every MasterCard fleet transaction.

businessRequirements.title: The cardholder receipt suppresses the expiration date
businessRequirements.statement: The MasterCard fleet expiration date is not printed on the cardholder copy of the receipt.

businessRequirements.title: Authorizations send an expiration value even for expired cards
businessRequirements.statement: Authorization Only transactions send an expiration value even when the card is expired.
businessRequirements.interpretation: Applied to Authorization Only transaction codes 3 and 5; whether purchases count as authorizations needs review.

businessRequirements.title: The full account number passes Mod 10
businessRequirements.statement: A Mod 10 check digit evaluation is performed on the full MasterCard fleet account number.

businessRequirements.title: Product Restriction Code is read and fuel-only restricts products
businessRequirements.statement: The device reads the Product Restriction Code; value 2 (fuel only) allows only fuel Product Codes and value 1 allows all products.
businessRequirements.interpretation: Fuel means the Appendix B fuel categories; values other than 1 and 2 conflict between the track layouts and Appendix A (MCF-R20).

businessRequirements.title: Each fuel type uses a unique Product Code
businessRequirements.statement: Product codes in one transaction are unique.

businessRequirements.title: Product Code Data is sent in every fleet transaction
businessRequirements.statement: Every MasterCard fleet transaction carries at least one product.

businessRequirements.title: Product amounts sum to the transaction amount
businessRequirements.statement: The sum of product amounts equals the transaction amount.
businessRequirements.interpretation: Drafted only for transactions without discounts, coupons or separate taxes.

businessRequirements.title: Track 2 is used first, then unaltered Track 1, then manual entry
businessRequirements.statement: An original transaction sends Track 2 when readable, otherwise unaltered Track 1 when readable, otherwise manual entry.

businessRequirements.title: Follow-on transactions carry partial Track 2
businessRequirements.statement: A follow-on transaction carries only the account number, an equals sign and the YYMM expiration date.

businessRequirements.title: Track 1 is sent without the Start Sentinel
businessRequirements.statement: Transmitted Track 1 data does not include the Start Sentinel.

businessRequirements.title: Track data follows the MasterCard fleet layouts
businessRequirements.statement: Track 1 and Track 2 data follow the published field order, lengths, separators and Product Type Code values 1 to 5.

businessRequirements.title: Prompt Code combines the transaction type and card type
businessRequirements.statement: The Prompt Code is the one-character transaction type code followed by the three-digit card type code.

businessRequirements.title: Products use Petroleum Appendix B Product Codes
businessRequirements.statement: Every product is represented by a Product Code defined in Petroleum Appendix B.

businessRequirements.title: Keyed entry prompts only for ID and Odometer
businessRequirements.statement: When the card is keyed, the device prompts for ID and Odometer and does not prompt for Driver ID or Vehicle Number.
